# Mayan Origin

> Specialty coffee from Honduras, rooted in Mayan heritage. Ships worldwide.

Mayan Origin is a direct-to-consumer brand sourcing single-origin coffee and traditional Honduran products from small cooperatives and artisan roasters in Honduras. Every order is packed fresh in Honduras and shipped worldwide via FedEx/DHL Express.

## Products

### Mayan Origin Coffees

- **Balam (El Jaguar)** — Dark roast. Washed process. Copán, Honduras. 1,400–1,600 masl. Notes of dark chocolate, smoky cedar, and dried cherry. $18 (250g) / $32 (500g) / $58 (1kg). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/balam/
- **Ixchel (La Diosa de la Luna)** — Light roast. Natural process. Copán, Honduras. 1,500–1,700 masl. Notes of jasmine, white peach, and honey finish. $19 (250g) / $34 (500g) / $62 (1kg). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/ixchel/
- **Kukulkan (La Serpiente Emplumada)** — Medium roast. Honey process. Copán, Honduras. 1,350–1,550 masl. Notes of brown sugar, toasted almond, and citrus. $17 (250g) / $30 (500g) / $55 (1kg). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/kukulkan/

### Café Welchez

Fifth-generation coffee farmers from Copán, Honduras.

- **House Blend** — Medium roast. Natural + Washed process. Copán, Honduras. 1,000–1,300 masl. Dark chocolate, caramel, bright citrus acidity. $29 (12oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/welchez-house-blend/
- **Santa Isabel** — Light roast. Washed process. Santa Isabel Farm, Copán, Honduras. 1,000–1,300 masl. Varieties: Parainema, Catuaí, Caturra. Sweet, acidic, chocolatey aroma. $25 (12oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/welchez-santa-isabel/

### Café Maya

Over 63 years of roasting tradition. Produced in Valle de Amarateca, Honduras.

- **Coffee Club (Whole Bean)** — Medium roast. Washed. 100% Honduran arabica. Mayan Roast profile. $23 (12oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/cafe-maya-coffee-club/
- **Coffee Club (Ground)** — Medium roast. Washed. 100% Honduran arabica. Mayan Roast profile. $21 (12oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/cafe-maya-coffee-club/
- **Reserva** — Medium roast. Washed. 100% Honduran arabica. Premium tier. $17 (12oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/cafe-maya-reserva/

### Sigua Coffee

Farming and roasting in Honduras since 2013. Regenerative agriculture, full farm traceability.

- **Finca El Zapote** — Medium roast. Washed. Finca El Zapote, Siguatepeque, Honduras. 1,550 masl. Hand-selected arabica. $28 (16oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/sigua-finca-el-zapote/

### Mythoz Café

National Winner — Global Coffee Awards 2025.

- **Mythoz Classic (Whole Bean)** — Medium roast. Washed. Honduras (5 regions). Up to 1,800 masl. Direct-trade from 109+ producer families. Creamy, nutty, clean citrus acidity. $46 (16oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/mythoz-classic/
- **Mythoz Classic (Ground)** — Medium roast. Washed. Honduras (5 regions). Up to 1,800 masl. Direct-trade from 109+ producer families. Creamy, nutty, clean citrus acidity. $46 (16oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/mythoz-classic/

## Brand

- Founded to bring Honduran specialty coffee to the US market and beyond
- Mayan Origin house coffees named after Mayan gods: Balam (jaguar god), Ixchel (moon goddess), Kukulkan (feathered serpent)
- House coffees sourced from CAFICO and COCAFCAL cooperatives in Copán, Honduras
- Partner brands: Café Welchez, Café Maya, Sigua Coffee, Mythoz Café
- All products packed fresh in Honduras and shipped worldwide

## Where to Buy

All products ship worldwide from Honduras via FedEx/DHL Express. Free Express shipping on orders over $100.

Shop: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/
Homepage: https://mayanorigin.com/
About: https://mayanorigin.com/about/
Blog: https://mayanorigin.com/blog/

## Content

The Mayan Origin blog covers:
- Mayan history and gods (Kukulkan, Ixchel, Balam)
- Honduran coffee origins (Copán, Marcala)
- Recipes using Honduran ingredients (hot chocolate, vanilla extract)
- Coffee brewing guides (French press, pour over)

Blog: https://mayanorigin.com/blog/
